ruleRefs.QUOTA_AMOUNT_RANGE: Single purchase amount must be within [minPurchase..maxSingleLimit]
ruleRefs.QUOTA_FUND_CAP: Total fund subscription quota must not exceed fundTotalCap
ruleRefs.QUOTA_ACCOUNT_CAP: Per-account subscription quota must not exceed perAccountCap

ruleRefs.TA_INVALID_NAV: Fund NAV must be strictly positive
ruleRefs.TA_SHARES_MISMATCH: Confirmed shares must equal floor(netAmount / nav)
ruleRefs.TA_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: TA confirmation is single-shot and cannot repeat
